name: El Niño / La Niña
summary: Very strong El Niño: Oceanic Niño Index +2.46°C for Aug–Oct; next value due early December
state: NOAA's Oceanic Niño Index for August–October, still the latest available on 27 Nov, was +2.46°C, far above the +1.5°C threshold for a strong event and up from +2.16°C for July–September (NOAA CPC). The index has risen in every three-month period since spring. The next value, for September–November, is due in early December.
for_you: Strong El Niño years tend to bring drought to parts of southern Africa, South-East Asia and Australia and heavy rain to parts of South America, affecting harvests and food prices; follow national met service seasonal outlooks.
why: ENSO reshapes global weather for a year at a time — droughts, floods, hurricanes and crop yields.
drivers: Pacific trade winds and ocean heat content.
